'''City Hall''' was the main government building in the settlement of [[Tarlam]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], located in [[Tarlam Central Square]]. The rear wing of the building was the mayoral residence, with its own shuttlepad. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Erkens]] and her staff were cornered and nearly [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[isotope-5 droid]] in front of the building before being rescued.<ref name="TOR" />
